column5: NDTiff: Bio-Formats ignores NDTiff.index and reads the file as a plain TIFF (112 pages as time points); scopeio uses the index axes (C 2, Z 7, T 8), same pixels in another plane order
NDTiff read as plain TIFF (9 pages, including the overwritten image); scopeio: 2 positions of C 2, Z 2 from the index, spec-derived truth is the reference

stack without OME-XML: Bio-Formats reads only this file as a plain TIFF (4 pages); scopeio follows the index maps of all three files of the acquisition (2 positions, continuation file), spec-derived truth is the reference
